description: Covers what's going around: US COVID, flu and RSV levels nationally or by state, with optional county wastewater details. For other countries, find outbreak reports, travel health notices and local public health resources. Use Trip for a full destination check.

country.description: Country for local resources; defaults to the US

location.description: US state, optional county, or country

query.description: Question such as 'flu in WA' or 'outbreaks in Mexico'

state.description: US state name or two-letter code, e.g. 'WA'

name: check_illness
title: Illness: levels, trends, outbreaks
